description: Machine-readable path-ownership map for parallel agent execution. Source of truth is docs/parallel-execution-plan.md section 6; this file is what scripts/check-lane-ownership.mjs enforces. Exactly one lane owns any given path within a wave. Globs support *, **, ?, {a,b} and ! negation (negations are applied after inclusions).

conventions.waveBarrier: A wave merges and its gate passes before the next wave starts. Lanes within a wave are fully parallel.
conventions.crossBoundaryRule: An agent that needs a change outside its owned globs must stop and report a planning defect. It must never edit across the boundary.

preWave.title: Pre-wave planning artifacts (already built, not an agent lane)

waves.name: Contracts and security core
waves.exitGate: Migrations apply clean and idempotent; RLS isolation suite green in CI; typecheck and lint green; ownership validator rejects a deliberate cross-lane edit.

lanes.title: Repository scaffold, tooling, integration stubs
lanes.exitGate: Empty app builds; CI green; ownership validator rejects a deliberate cross-lane edit; no secret reachable from the client bundle.

lanes.title: Migration 0002 — RLS helpers and policy matrix
lanes.exitGate: Applies to a fresh database, idempotent on re-run; the w0-l6 isolation suite turns green against it.

lanes.title: Migration 0003 — triggers, RPCs, schema fixes, job table
lanes.exitGate: Illegal ticket transitions and activity mutations rejected at the database level, proven by w0-l6 tests.

lanes.title: Shared contracts package
lanes.exitGate: packages/shared typechecks standalone; unit tests pass; no feature lane needs to add an export.

lanes.title: Runtime security library and the handler wrapper
lanes.exitGate: A probe route returns the exact frozen envelope for 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429 and 500.

lanes.title: Test infrastructure and the RLS isolation suite
lanes.exitGate: HARD GATE. Full isolation suite green in CI and every policy in the matrix exercised by at least one passing assertion. Blocks all of wave 1.

waves.name: Feature verticals
waves.exitGate: All six lanes merged; every lane's tests green; ownership validator clean on all six diffs; RLS suite still green.

lanes.title: Identity, organizations, invitations
lanes.exitGate: Invitation lifecycle tested; non-admin cannot invite; an accepted member receives exactly their role's visibility.

lanes.title: Properties and units
lanes.exitGate: Contracts in api-contracts.md implemented with the standard envelope; manager writes, owner read-only, tenant sees only leased property, provider sees only ticket-linked property.

lanes.title: Tenants and tenancies
lanes.exitGate: A signed-in tenant sees only their own tenancy; cross-tenant PII read denied; overlapping active tenancy on one unit rejected.

lanes.title: Maintenance workflow
lanes.exitGate: Every illegal transition rejected; provider cannot read or touch unassigned work; every transition leaves exactly one activity row.

lanes.title: AI maintenance intake
lanes.exitGate: Eval set passes including prompt injection and malformed JSON; no model output path can reach a privileged action.

lanes.title: Documents, extraction, job runner
lanes.exitGate: Nothing verified without a human action; a permanently failing job dead-letters; a duplicate enqueue processes once.

waves.name: Cross-cutting completion and demo
waves.exitGate: Every release gate in docs/test-plan.md green; security audit findings closed or explicitly accepted with rationale.
waves.notes: w2-l3 is the sole writer on feature code during this wave. Ownership of app/, features/ and services/ transfers to it because no feature lane is active.

lanes.title: End-to-end suite
lanes.exitGate: The ten-step scenario in test-plan.md passes, including the cross-organization denial assertion; CI smoke subset under five minutes.

lanes.title: Demo seed data and walkthrough
lanes.exitGate: Idempotent re-seed produces two organizations, ten principals, tickets in every status, and one verified plus one pending document.

lanes.title: Security audit and remediation (sole feature-code writer)
lanes.exitGate: Every line of security-checklist.md has recorded evidence; adversarial IDOR, organization-injection, signed-URL replay and prompt-injection passes all clean; every suite re-run green.

lanes.title: Observability, performance, resilience
lanes.exitGate: Correlation IDs traced end to end including into job rows; health and readiness endpoints live; dead-letter alerting in place; runbook written.

lanes.title: Role dashboards and UX completion
lanes.exitGate: Five role-specific dashboards compose the six Wave 1 widgets; every surface has empty, loading and error states; accessibility pass clean.

lanes.title: Deployment and documentation close-out
lanes.exitGate: README quick start verified from a clean clone; api-contracts.md reconciled with shipped routes; backlog closed out; release-gate evidence recorded.
